description_en: Queries the list of AI model providers
kebab_example: aliyun apig list-ai-model-providers --gateway-id gw-8c13d2b4f8a1 --provider qwen --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAiModelProviders

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AI gateway instance. The target instance must exist, belong to the current account, and be of the AI gateway type
parameters.help_zh: AI 网关实例 ID。目标实例必须存在、属于当前账号且类型为 AI 网关
parameters.name: gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The fuzzy match condition for the model provider identifier. If left empty, all model providers under the current gateway are queried
parameters.help_zh: 模型供应商标识的模糊匹配条件。留空时查询当前网关下全部模型供应商
parameters.name: provider

parameters.help_en: The page number. Default value: 1. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码。默认值为 1，取值大于或等于 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 每页数量。默认值为 10，取值范围为 1～500
parameters.name: page_size
